title: Window 1 s at 10 ms steps (control for the 50 ms spacing) · total torque
description: Total-torque version (nothing subtracted): Control: the same 1 s history as "Length 1 s" but with all 100 steps of 10 ms. If the two score the same, the 50 ms spacing used for long windows does not change the result. Everything else as the reference: Active torque (each session's own relaxed-hold passive torque subtracted), EMG ÷ session-1 maximum, no per-angle loss scaling (plain mean-squared error, every angle weighted by its own torque), LSTM 8×2 trained with batch 64 (fast protocol: learning rate × 0.5 after 6 flat epochs, early stop 15, at most 150 epochs), trained on session 1 and tested on session 2, 6 people × 10 seeds. The EMG envelope is causal (forward-only filters: no input uses later EMG, as in a real-time device; 2nd-order 2 Hz low-pass, about 125 ms lag) and the first and last 1 s of every trial are cut. Validation windows start one window span after the training part of each trial, so no validation window reuses training inputs (purged split).
